summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Consumer Discretionary 2x Daily ETF (XLYX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR Fund (Ticker: XLY), which provides exposure to US consumer-discretionary stocks. XLYX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
